item.bloxpiece.hito_hito_no_mi_model_dai: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu
message.bloxpiece.no_room: Not enough room above the target
race.bloxpiece.human.description: The most common race of the seas. Balanced, no strength nor weakness: their power will come from their will.
race.bloxpiece.fishman.description: Born under the waves, stronger than the average human. Swims fast and breathes underwater.
message.bloxpiece.fishman.busy: You are already in the middle of an attack.
From your stance, you thrust your fist: a wave of compressed water bursts forward and knocks back whatever it crosses.
race.bloxpiece.attack.fishman_water_spea: You gather dozens of water droplets around your hands, then hurl them in three volleys at very high speed: they pierce lined-up enemies.
race.bloxpiece.attack.fishman_devastatin: You slam the ground with both hands: a huge wave spreads all around you and throws enemies back.
race.bloxpiece.attack.fishman_abyss_pier: Ultimate: water swirls around your arm, then a gigantic spiral of water bursts from your fist and explodes on impact.
race.bloxpiece.lunarian.description: Legendary people with black wings and a flame on their back. Sturdy, they barely fear fire.
message.bloxpiece.lunarian.busy: You are already in the middle of an attack.
message.bloxpiece.lunarian.no_sky: Not enough room above you to take off.
race.bloxpiece.attack.lunarian_flame_mod: Lights or puts out the flames on your back. Lit: much tougher, but your damage is greatly reduced. Out: faster.
race.bloxpiece.attack.lunarian_burning_f: Your wings open and hurl burning feathers, one after another, at the enemies in front of you.
race.bloxpiece.attack.lunarian_blazing_f: Fist ablaze, you dash in the aimed direction, on the ground or in the air: it explodes on contact.
race.bloxpiece.attack.lunarian_celestial: Ultimate: you soar high, dive fist-first onto your starting point and raise a gigantic fire tornado that sweeps enemies away.
race.bloxpiece.cyborg.description: A body reinforced with mechanical parts. Tougher, steadier, less affected by poison.
race.bloxpiece.minks.description: A tribe of quick and agile animal folk, bound to electricity. Fast on their feet and in combat.
race.bloxpiece.bonus.flame_guard: +%s armor points in Defense mode (back flames lit)
race.bloxpiece.bonus.effect_resist: Poison and hunger wear off %s times faster
race.bloxpiece.attack.human_lightning_im: Your fist gathers strength, then strikes straight ahead at blinding speed: a shockwave and light knockback on one target.
race.bloxpiece.attack.human_destructive_: Brace yourself and charge forward: your shoulder slams into the first enemy and sends it flying.
race.bloxpiece.attack.human_earth_breake: Smash your fist into the ground: the earth cracks and a huge circular shockwave sweeps all around you.
race.bloxpiece.attack.human_conqueror_fi: Ultimate: gather all your power, then unleash a punch that hurls a gigantic shockwave and a massive explosion.
Your mechanical arm turns into a cannon and fires a huge cannonball that explodes on impact.
race.bloxpiece.attack.cyborg_energy_shie: A dome of blue hexagons protects you for 8 s: no hit, projectile or enemy gets through.
race.bloxpiece.attack.cyborg_engine_over: 15 s: +35% damage, +30% speed and attack speed, +4 armor. Then 3 min of exhaustion.
race.bloxpiece.attack.cyborg_radical_bea: Hands joined, a giant yellow laser beam fires straight ahead and causes a huge explosion.
message.bloxpiece.attack_set.no_fruit: No Devil Fruit: your keys always use your race's attacks (%s).
message.bloxpiece.cyborg.busy: Your mechanical arm is already in action.
message.bloxpiece.human.busy: You are already in the middle of an attack.
message.bloxpiece.minks.busy: You are already in the middle of an attack.
message.bloxpiece.minks.no_space: Not enough room around you for the Lightning Claw Dance.
message.bloxpiece.minks.sulong_already: You are already in Sulong form.
message.bloxpiece.minks.sulong_day: Sulong is only possible at night.
message.bloxpiece.minks.sulong_limit: You already transformed into Sulong %s times tonight. Wait for the next night.
message.bloxpiece.minks.sulong_no_moon: There is no night here: Sulong is impossible.
message.bloxpiece.cyborg.exhausted: Engine exhausted: you are weakened for %s min.
race.bloxpiece.attack.minks_electric_cla: Electric claws spring from your hands (20 s): your bare-handed hits deal more damage and briefly stun.
race.bloxpiece.attack.minks_claw_barrage: A flurry of clawed punches in front of you, ending with one powerful blow.
race.bloxpiece.attack.minks_lightning_da: You dart like lightning all around the area, striking from every side, then finish with an area blow.
race.bloxpiece.attack.minks_sulong.descr: Ultimate, at night only (twice per night): 30 s transformation. Much stronger, faster and tougher; your Minks attacks are empowered.
tooltip.bloxpiece.race_reroll_token.desc: Changes your race to a new random one.
tooltip.bloxpiece.race_reroll_token.use: Race menu (inventory or G key > Race) > Reroll.

ability.bloxpiece.buddha_shockwave.name: Shockwave
ability.bloxpiece.buddha_shockwave.descr: Colossal palm and golden cone wave. Heavy damage, huge knockback.
ability.bloxpiece.buddha_ultimate.name: Buddha Blast
ability.bloxpiece.buddha_ultimate.descri: Hold then release: golden sphere all around. Fully charged: 2x bigger.
ability.bloxpiece.ice_saber.name: Ice Saber
ability.bloxpiece.ice_saber.description: Ice trident in hand: heavy damage, slows. Use again to remove it.
ability.bloxpiece.ice_partisan.name: Partisan
ability.bloxpiece.ice_partisan.descripti: Throw the trident: freezes the target, ice spikes on impact.
ability.bloxpiece.ice_eagle.name: Pheasant Peck
ability.bloxpiece.ice_eagle.description: Ice eagle that pierces and knocks back enemies.
ability.bloxpiece.ice_age.name: Ice Age
ability.bloxpiece.ice_age.description: Freezes everything within 28 blocks and traps enemies.

screen.bloxpiece.quests.unique.hint: Talk to Silvers Rayleigh, in the village, to get one.
screen.bloxpiece.quests.repeatable.hint: The Tavern Keeper, in the village, always has work for you.
screen.bloxpiece.quests.repeatable.hint_: Kills count automatically. Come back to the Tavern Keeper once done.
Mission complete: go back to the Tavern Keeper to claim your XP!
quest.bloxpiece.repeatable.description.0: A small favor for the Tavern Keeper: nothing too nasty.
quest.bloxpiece.repeatable.description.1: A real gang to scatter: get ready to fight.
quest.bloxpiece.repeatable.description.2: Fearsome leaders or several factions: dangerous work.
quest.bloxpiece.repeatable.description.3: A mission few dare to accept. A big bounty awaits.
quest.bloxpiece.repeatable.sea_war.title: War of the Seas
quest.bloxpiece.repeatable.outlaws.title: Outlaws
quest.bloxpiece.repeatable.three_faction: No Pirates, No Bandits, No Marines

npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.missions.off: "%s": eliminate %s. Difficulty: %s. I'll give you %s XP when you're back. Interested?
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.missions.lat: As you wish. The mission will wait for you.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.missions.acc: Deal! Track "%s" in your menu, Repeatable quests tab, and come back when it's done.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.missions.don: Well done on "%s"! Here's your bounty: %s XP.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.missions.cla: +%s XP. Come back anytime, I'll have another mission for you.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.missions.non: Give me a second, I'm preparing your next mission... Ask me again.
message.bloxpiece.repeatable.complete: Mission complete: %s! Go back to the Tavern Keeper for your reward.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.quests.la: Take your time. Willpower can't be rushed.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.quests.ac: It's a deal. Track your progress in your menu, Unique Quests tab: "%s".
You haven't finished "%s". Check the Unique Quests tab of your menu, and come back when your will is ready.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.quests.lo: You're not ready yet. Reach level %s, and I'll teach you %s.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.quests.ev: You've awakened all three Haki. Their evolutions... I'll teach you those later, when the time comes.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.quests.al: I have nothing left to teach you, kid.
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_armament.tit: The Awakening of Will – Armament Haki
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_armament.des: Rayleigh wants to test your will: take down Humandrills and harden your fists on monsters.
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_armament.off: Your will can harden your body like steel. Prove it: take down 25 Humandrills and strike monsters 200 times with your bare fists. Then you'll master Armament.
Learn to sense the presence of others. (Temporary trial: the real quest will come later.)
Close your eyes and listen... The world is speaking to you. For now, break a single block and come back to feel what surrounds you: I'll awaken your Observation.
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_conqueror.ti: The Will of a King – Conqueror's Haki
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_conqueror.de: Only the chosen carry the will of a king. (Temporary trial: the real quest will come later.)
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_conqueror.of: I sense the will of a king in you... For now, break a block: this trial will change. But your Conqueror's Haki will awaken.
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_observation_: Seeing the Future – Evolved Observation Haki
quest.bloxpiece.unique.haki_conqueror_ev: The Coating of Kings – Evolved Conqueror's Haki
Push Conqueror's Haki beyond its limits.
screen.bloxpiece.quests.unique.unrelease: Not available yet: its content will come later.

ability.bloxpiece.gura_kaishin.descripti: Seismic cone wave: damage, knockback, carves terrain (20 blocks).
ability.bloxpiece.gura_gekishin.name: Gekishin
ability.bloxpiece.gura_gekishin.descript: Seismic charge: bursts on contact and leaves a crater.
ability.bloxpiece.gura_kabutowari.name: Kabutowari
ability.bloxpiece.gura_kabutowari.descri: Strike the ground: 10-block quake, enemies launched.
ability.bloxpiece.gura_shima_yurashi.des: Hold then release: 12 to 28-block quake, stuns.

npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.name: Tavern Keeper
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.greeting: Welcome to the tavern, sailor! What do you want to know?
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.kit.received: Welcome, cabin boy! Here is your starter kit: some food and a pirate saber. Good luck at sea!
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.kit.already: I already gave you your starter kit, cabin boy. What do you want to know?
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.kit.full: I have a starter kit for you, but your bag is full! Make some room (two slots) and come back.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.fruit.questi: How do I get a Devil Fruit?
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.fruit.answer: Only Treasure Chests hold them. Pirate captains guard them on their ships. Open one: the roulette picks your fruit. Eat it to gain its powers.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.mastery.answ: Earn BloxPiece XP: fights, quests and XP crystals. Each level raises your health and fruit power, and unlocks new attacks.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.village.answ: A safe haven: nobody gets hurt here and nothing can be destroyed. The Village Compass always leads you back.
npc.bloxpiece.tavern_keeper.start.answer: Open your character menu (G): stats, attacks and daily quests. And beware: water and seastone block fruit powers!
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.name: Silvers Rayleigh
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.greeting: Oh? A young pirate full of ambition... Come closer, I don't bite. Not much anymore.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.quests.an: Not yet, kid. Come back soon: I'll have missions worthy of you, and fine rewards.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.haki.answ: A power every living being has: Observation to sense, Armament to strike. And Conqueror's Haki... only a chosen few carry it.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.roger.que: Did you know Gol D. Roger?
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.roger.ans: I was his first mate. A man who laughed in the face of death... If you ever meet his shadow, get ready for the fight of your life.
npc.bloxpiece.silvers_rayleigh.who.answe: Just an old man having a drink at the tavern. Long ago, they called me the Dark King.
haki.bloxpiece.armament.name: Armament Haki
haki.bloxpiece.armament.description: Press: hardened arm (+70% damage). Hold: full body (+45% damage, -45% taken). Swordman: imbued weapon (+15%).
haki.bloxpiece.observation.name: Observation Haki
haki.bloxpiece.observation.description: Dodge every attack while your Haki gauge lasts (not fire, falls or drowning).
haki.bloxpiece.conqueror.name: Conqueror's Haki
haki.bloxpiece.conqueror.description: Red and black wave: everything within 12 blocks faints for 8 s.

ability.bloxpiece.goro_mamaragan.name: Mamaragan
ability.bloxpiece.goro_mamaragan.descrip: A large thundercloud charges above you, strikes every creature around and keeps them electrified for several seconds: steady damage and paralysis, without harming the terrain.
ability.bloxpiece.goro_kari.name: Kari
ability.bloxpiece.goro_kari.description: Lightning rain: electric clouds form above the targeted area, and each one unleashes a huge blue bolt that blasts a crater.
ability.bloxpiece.goro_el_thor.name: El Thor
ability.bloxpiece.goro_el_thor.descripti: A huge cloud charges above the targeted spot, then a giant pillar of lightning crashes down and digs a crater.
ability.bloxpiece.goro_raigo.name: Raigo
ability.bloxpiece.goro_raigo.description: Hold to form a gigantic electric sphere above you, release: it crashes onto the targeted area and explodes.
